title: DGX Spark LLM Bench
description: Live benchmarks of local LLMs on DGX Spark: how many parallel agent sessions one box sustains, at what tokens/sec and latency. Interactive dashboard, one-command recipes, measured numbers.

title: tok-sim
description: Visual tokens/sec simulator: see what a given speed looks like generating prose, code, math and more, with a side-by-side comparison mode.

title: Voxel Bridge Challenge
description: One prompt, many local models. Each builds the same self-contained Three.js voxel world: a 40-block arch bridge, an earthquake rebuild and a widening river. Live side-by-side comparison.
